rounds.lesson:
GOAL: PS I se nikla electron NADP⁺ tak jaane ke bajay waapas laut aaye, toh kya ATP phir bhi ban sakta hai?
MISAAL: bus ka raasta: ek bus aage doosre terminal tak jaati hai; doosri ghoomkar apne starting stop par laut aati hai.
LESSON
[p009-i27]
Humne dekha ki water PS II ko electrons deta hai, aur aage unse NADPH banta hai.
Ab sawaal hai: PS I ka electron NADP⁺ tak jaane ke bajay laut aaye, toh kya ATP phir bhi banega?
Iska jawab electron ke do alag raaston ko samajhne se milega.
Pehle yaad karo, ATP cells ke kaamon ko kharch karne layak energy deta hai.
Jeev oxidisable substances se energy nikaalkar use chemical roop mein rakh sakte hain.
Oxidisable substances woh hain jo electrons dekar khud oxidised ho sakte hain.
Oxidation electron dena hai; reduction electron lena hai, jaisa hum pehle samajh chuke hain.
Molecules mein atoms ko jodne wale chemical bonds hote hain.
Unki chemical banawat se judi energy ko yahaan bond energy keh rahe hain.
ATP jaise molecules isi chemical roop mein energy lekar cells ke doosre kaamon tak pahunchate hain.
Ek baat saaf rakho: sirf bond todna apne-aap energy nahi deta.
Bond todne mein energy lagti hai; poore chemical badlav mein naye bonds banne ke saath net energy mil sakti hai.
ATP se ADP aur phosphate banne wala poora badlav cells ko kaam ki energy de sakta hai.

[p010-i1]
Ab isi ATP ko banane ki taraf chalo.
ATP ka poora naam adenosine triphosphate hai; tri yahaan teen phosphate groups batata hai.
ADP adenosine diphosphate hai; di do phosphate groups batata hai.
ADP mein ek aur phosphate jodne par ATP ban sakta hai, lekin iske liye energy chahiye.
Yeh alag se maujood phosphate inorganic phosphate kehlaata hai.
Iska chhota sanket Pi hai; pehle figure mein isi ke liye iP likha tha.
Yahaan ADP mein phosphate jodkar ATP banane ko phosphorylation kehte hain.
Cells mein mitochondria aur chloroplasts, dono mein ATP banne ka yeh kaam hota hai.
Mitochondria respiration se jude cell ke compartments hain; unka ATP banana aage respiration mein samjhenge.
Chloroplast mein jab light ki madad se ADP aur inorganic phosphate se ATP banta hai, use photo-phosphorylation kehte hain.
Photo ka matlab light hai, aur phosphorylation yahaan phosphate jodkar ATP banana hai.
ADP + Pi se ATP banta hai; is jodne ke liye energy light-driven kaam se milti hai.
Ab teen baatein dekhenge: pehle jaana hua khula electron raasta, phir lautne wala raasta, aur aakhir unki jagah aur products.

[p010-i2]
Pehle jaana hua Z scheme yaad karo.
PS ka matlab photosystem hai; PS I aur PSI, dono Photosystem I likhne ke tareeke hain.
PS II ka reaction centre P680 aur PS I ka P700 hai.
Dono mein light electron ko zyada energy wali state mein pahunchati hai.
Water se replacement electron PS II ko milta hai.
PS II se electron acceptor aur carriers ki kadi ke raaste PS I tak pahunchta hai.
Electron ko ek se doosre tak dene wali isi kadi ko electron transport chain kehte hain.
PS I par light doosra energy boost deti hai; aage electrons NADP⁺ ke reduction mein lagte hain.
NADP⁺ electrons lene wala carrier hai; electrons lekar yeh NADPH banta hai.
Isliye electron ka raasta ghoomkar usi shuruaat par waapas nahi aata.
Aise flow se jude ATP banne ko non-cyclic photo-phosphorylation kehte hain.
Non-cyclic ka matlab hai shuruaat par lautkar chakkar poora na karna.
Ismein dono photosystems ek ke baad ek kaam karte hain: pehle PS II, phir PS I.
Inhe jodne wali electron transport chain wahi hai jo humne Z scheme mein dekhi.
Is electron flow se ATP aur NADPH, dono bante hain; water splitting se O₂ bhi milti hai.
NADPH + H⁺ likha mile, toh yaad rakho: reduced carrier NADPH hai; saath ka H⁺ proton hai.

[analogy]
Ab bus ke do raaste socho.
Pehli bus apne starting stop se nikalti hai aur aage doosre terminal tak pahunchti hai.
Doosri bus bhi nikalti hai, lekin uska raasta ghoomkar starting stop par hi laut aata hai.
Pehli bus ka safar aage ki manzil par khatam hua; doosri ne ek chakkar poora kiya.
Yahaan bus electron ko aur stops electron lene-dene wale molecules ko samjho.
Non-cyclic flow mein electron aage NADP⁺ tak jaata hai.
Ab doosre raaste mein dekhenge ki PS I se nikla electron ghoomkar PS I par kaise laut sakta hai.

[p010-i3]
Figure 11.6 mein pehle Photosystem I ka bracket dekho; yahaan isi photosystem ka raasta dikhaya hai.
Neeche Chlorophyll P 700 likha hai, jo PS I ka reaction centre hai.
Light se aata dashed yellow arrow isi P700 ki taraf hai.
Light milne par electron excited hota hai, yaani zyada energy wali state mein pahunchta hai.
P700 se seedha pink arrow upar e⁻ acceptor tak jaata hai.
e⁻ electron ka sanket hai; e⁻ acceptor us electron ko lene wala molecule hai.
Ab acceptor se curved pink arrow ko neeche Electron transport system tak dekho.
Yeh system electron ko carriers ke raaste aage deta hai.
Agla pink arrow usi P700 par laut raha hai, jahaan se electron nikla tha.
Ghoomkar shuruaat par lautne ko cyclic kehte hain; yahaan electron ka chakkar band ho gaya.
Transport system ke paas ADP + Pi se ATP ki taraf curved black arrow hai.
ADP aur inorganic phosphate starting substances hain; ATP yahaan banne wala product hai.
Isliye is lautne wale electron flow se bhi phosphorylation judi hai.
Isi ko cyclic photophosphorylation kehte hain.
Dhyaan do, figure mein PS II nahi hai aur NADP⁺ ko electron dene wali branch bhi nahi hai.
Electron ke lautne wale arrows aur ATP banne wala arrow alag pehchaano; electron khud ATP ka hissa nahi ban raha.

[example]
Ab P700 se nikle ek electron ka safar ungli rakhkar poora karo.
Pehle light se excitation hui, phir electron acceptor ne use liya.
Acceptor se electron transport system mein gaya aur wahaan se P700 par laut aaya.
Yeh hamari ghoomkar lautne wali bus ka raasta hai.
Saath mein ADP aur Pi se ATP banne ka kaam juda hai.
Electron NADP⁺ tak gaya hi nahi, isliye is chakkar se NADPH nahi bana.
Ek electron ka chakkar dekhkar ek ATP banne ki ginti mat nikaalna; figure aisa anupaat nahi deti.

[p010-i12]
Ab is figure ki baat ko poore chloroplast ki jagah se jodo.
Jab sirf PS I functional hota hai, electron transport chain se nikla electron PS I par laut sakta hai.
Functional ka matlab yahaan kaam kar raha hona hai.
Is cyclic flow se ATP banta hai, lekin NADPH + H⁺ nahi banta.
PS II-associated water splitting is raaste ka hissa nahi hai, isliye cyclic flow khud net O₂ nahi banata.
Ab jagah yaad karo: grana thylakoid thailiyon ke dher hain.
Un dheron ko jodne wali bina dher ki membrane pattiyan stroma lamellae hain.
Inke aas-paas ka fluid stroma hai; stroma aur stroma lamellae alag cheezein hain.
Grana ki membranes ya lamellae mein PS I aur PS II, dono milte hain.
Stroma lamellae membranes mein PS II aur NADP reductase enzyme nahi hote.
Enzyme chemical reaction ko tezi se karane mein madad karta hai.
NADP⁺ ko electrons milkar NADPH banne mein madad karne wala enzyme NADP reductase kehlaata hai.
Reductase naam reduction karane wale enzyme ko batata hai; enzyme khud electrons ka mool source nahi hai.
Isliye stroma lamellae cyclic photophosphorylation ki ek possible location hain.
Possible location ko eklauti location mat samajhna.
Yahaan electron NADP⁺ ko dene ke bajay electron transport chain se PS I par laut sakta hai.
Cyclic photophosphorylation tab bhi hoti hai jab excitation ke liye sirf 680 nm se aage ki wavelengths milti hain.
Aage ka matlab yahaan 680 nm se badi wavelength hai, zyada energy wali light kehna nahi.
PS II ka centre P680 hai, jabki PS I ka P700; is condition mein PS I wala cyclic raasta chal sakta hai.

[checkpoint]
Ab dono raaston ka clue tumhare paas hai: NADPH banne ke liye electrons NADP⁺ tak jaane chahiye.
Socho, phir aage badhenge: electron har chakkar ke baad P700 par laut raha ho, toh ATP ke saath NADPH bhi banega?
Aapne socha hoga ki NADPH nahi banega, kyunki electron NADP⁺ ko milne ke bajay P700 par laut raha hai.
Lekin ATP ban sakta hai, kyunki cyclic electron transport se bhi ATP banne ka kaam juda hai.
Aksar lagta hai ki light reaction chali toh ATP, NADPH aur O₂ teeno zaroor banenge.
Par cyclic flow ATP banata hai, bina net NADPH aur O₂ formation ke.

[example]
Ab dono raaston ko ek saath phir jodo.
Non-cyclic mein water electrons deta hai; PS II ke baad PS I kaam karta hai.
Electrons aage NADP⁺ tak pahunchte hain; ATP aur NADPH bante hain, aur water splitting se O₂ milti hai.
Cyclic mein sirf PS I ka electron acceptor aur transport system se ghoomkar PS I par laut aata hai.
Is flow ka product ATP hai; net NADPH ya O₂ nahi bante.
Toh shuruaat ka jawab yeh hai: PS I par electron lautne par bhi ATP ban sakta hai.
Ab jo baat kholni baaki hai, woh electron transport aur ATP banne ke beech ka asli jod hai.
